title: Lumera paper: one image to editable UE5/Blender scene with engine lights
summary: Announcement of Lumera research reconstructing a single image into separate editable meshes with movable engine lights and an extracted HDR environment instead of baking lighting into the reconstruction.
question_it_answers: What image-to-3D approach keeps lighting as editable engine parameters in UE5 or Blender?

claims.text: Lumera rebuilds each object as a separate mesh and recreates lighting as movable engine lights plus an HDR environment.
claims.evidence: rebuilds every object as a separate mesh, then recreates the lighting as actual engine lights you can move and tweak. Even pulls an HDR environment out of the shot.
claims.subject: image-to-3d-world

claims.text: Code and weights are marked as coming soon on the project page linked from the post.
claims.subject: image-to-3d-world

judge_hints.why_must_read: Engine-native editable lighting differs from baked image-to-3D meshes.
